Your next favorite customer might be waking up across the world right now.

Expanding globally used to demand a massive corporate budget and physical offices everywhere. Today, smart marketing and AI-driven automation let small businesses test new international waters without burning out the team.

So, how do you know you're ready to take that leap? Here are three clear signs:
• You're already getting organic visits or inquiries from other countries.
• Your core systems run smoothly on autopilot, giving you room to scale.
• Your solution solves a problem that isn't tied to one zip code.

Going global isn't about being huge; it's about having the right tools to support healthy growth.

Have you noticed international interest in your business lately? Tell us where your audience is reaching out from in the comments!
